name: Prey Brewing Company
notes: 5 photos. Photo 1 (main regular menu: Appetizers/Burgers/Plated/Dessert) and photo 4 (Weekend Brunch board) were merged, skipping items repeated verbatim on both (Smash Burger, Spicy Mushroom Deluxe Sandwich, House Salad, Shrimp & Grits). Photo 2 (Cocktails/Legacy/Top Shelf/Mocktails) is entirely alcoholic drinks plus non-alcoholic mixed 'mocktails' and was skipped as drink-only. Photo 3 (Happy Hour and Late Night Happy Hour boards) lists the same food items at temporary discounted prices plus beer/wine/cocktails/shots; skipped as a promotional pricing board, not new dishes, and alcohol. Photo 5 is a differently-styled (typewriter font) Burgers & Tacos list with some overlapping item names at different prices (Nashville Hot Chicken $18 vs $19, Smash Burger $15 vs $18) -- likely a separate/rotating food-truck or older menu insert; the conflicting duplicate names were skipped in favor of the primary menu's price, but its unique items (Classic Cheeseburger, Banh Mi Burger, and the Tacos section) were added since they don't appear elsewhere. Modifiers/add-ons (extra bacon, avocado, egg, bone luge shot, double meat, consomme, etc.) were skipped throughout.
